title: Christmas Cantata
description: Join us for our annual Christmas cantata featuring our choir and orchestra. A beautiful celebration of the birth of Christ through music and scripture.

title: Youth Group Christmas Party
description: An evening of games, food, and fellowship for our youth. Bring a white elephant gift under $15!

title: Christmas Eve Service
description: Celebrate the birth of our Savior with candlelight, carols, and communion. Two service times available.

title: New Year's Eve Prayer Service
description: Ring in the new year with prayer, worship, and reflection as we seek God's guidance for the year ahead.
